test_scaled_profile_matches_total_power: test the scaled_profile ICRH source to verify volume-integrated heating equals P_total times absorption_fraction
test_scaled_profile_no_shift_at_referenc: test the scaled_profile model returns profiles proportional to reference when B0 equals reference_B0
test_scaled_profile_returns_zero_fast_io: test the scaled_profile model always returns zero fast ion density
test_b0_shift_moves_peak: test the scaled_profile model shifts the heating profile peak to the analytically expected location when B0 differs from reference_B0
build_and_run_icrh_source: build a ToraxConfig with scaled_profile ICRH source and run the source to get ion, electron, and fast ion outputs
